svg.title: Assumption Input lines Preserved condition Scope control A11 Laplace continuity 14113– 14136 Positive future-cone measures with finite transforms on full open dual cone; common polynomial budget for Schwartz passage. No arbitrary signed-measure convergence assertion. A12 Maxwell isometry countertest 14220– 14252 Complex-linear isometry with physical image, vacuum/ translation intertwining, and precise local coherent matrix identity. Neither surjectivity nor identification of every field required; fixed-ball variant retained. A13 Projected and averaged variants 14326– 14329 Bounded self-adjoint fixed-image map for projected variant; physical inner-product preserving pointwise fixed-image maps for probability average. Individual averaged maps need no extra linearity, boundedness or projection property. A14 Near-kernel repair 14648– 14674 Finite real onto map with nonzero one-dimensional kernel, exact convergent right inverses and both weighted near-kernel errors. No prior uniform convergence on near-kernel direction assumed; precision paid before correction. A15 Mass and volume order 14890– 14982 Strictly positive mass through volume estimates; moving masses confined to a fixed positive interval after tolerance choice. Separate eventual endpoint estimates suffice; no uniform mass convergence is inserted. A16 Position normalization branch 15317– 15408 Complementary scalar/stress/ unit projections and positive adjustment factors; independent Wilson calibration of measured charge. Real fourth-order remainder belongs to normalized frame; weaker positive-ray norm alignment transfers leading coefficient only. A17 Marker and threshold order 15556– 15647 Finite surgery order fixed before eventual thresholds; common windows, two marker slots and positive weights, exact common Wilson partition. Uniformity in finer cutoff/ volume follows retained threshold order; no chamber-count tarifffactor. A18 Local lens admissibility 15686– 15766 Fixed read support, measurable equivariant displacement, health threshold θ/4, chord D with 8D≤θ, finite stocks and nonwrapping. Flag equality is branchwise exact; absent insertion requires no exponent estimate or hard-mask differentiation. A19 Activity domains and budgets 110–226 Threshold 0 < θ ≤1 with equality healthy; ordered left derivatives on healthy domains only; budgets at a fixed finite torus; early reserve s + 3. Masks are never differentiated; no volume-independent bound on the total scalar action is asserted. A20 Stationary corridor 5515–5709 Fixed derivative order n ≥2; counting gap and exponential weights; contraction on ∥x∥< RX, ∥v∥≤RV . Uniqueness of the stationary point only inside the corridor; off-shell values and the residual are retained.
